idea-plugin.name: Baseline
idea-plugin.description:
Baseline provides project-configurable Java and Kotlin formatting through IntelliJ IDEA's standard Reformat Code command.

Formatting

  • Separate static and instance fields; group by visibility and type.
  • Arrange independent fields from longest to shortest name and align initializer equals signs.
  • Arrange eligible constructor assignments and local declarations from shortest to longest name.
  • Format fluent chains, parameter lists and packed call arguments using the language right margin.
  • Control block, method, member, statement, lambda, annotation and file-section spacing.
  • Format logical conditions, ternaries, control headers, case separators and Kotlin Elvis fallbacks.

Project preferences and sharing

Open Settings / Editor / Baseline to configure 51 Boolean preferences. All defaults preserve the phase-one layout. Use Export settings and Import settings to share a portable XML profile with your team. Imported preferences are saved only after Apply or OK.

Usage and safeguards

Reformat the whole file without selecting a fragment. For formatting on save, enable Tools / Actions on Save / Reformat code / Whole file for Java and Kotlin. Baseline runs after native formatting; it does not replace the language formatting model.

Parameter, argument and method declaration order are preserved. Rearrangement is limited to eligible independent runs and stops at semantic barriers. Partial selections, files with syntax errors and enabled formatter-off regions retain native formatting. Native commit checks format changed code only; mandatory pre-push enforcement requires a separate integration. Profiles share Baseline preferences, not the IDE code-style scheme.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1 - Formatting fixes and scope cleanup

  • Remove generated-source visibility controls and Project view integration from Baseline.
  • Measure field cascades using the declared type and variable name.
  • Add optional grouping for fields sharing a snake_case or camelCase prefix.
  • Start assignment call chains at the receiver and pack arguments using the continuation width.
  • Keep short conditional-branch chains inline and wrap overlong branches at the right margin.
  • Preserve existing formatting preferences, argument order and conservative rearrangement safeguards.
  • Remove superseded deprecated revisions and give current methods canonical names.

1.0.0 - Initial stable release

  • Java and Kotlin formatting integrated with the native whole-file Reformat Code pipeline.
  • 50 project-specific Boolean preferences with Apply, Reset and Restore defaults.
  • Portable XML export/import, complete validation and non-destructive file replacement.
  • Static/visibility/type field groups, descending name cascades and initializer alignment.
  • Conservative constructor grouping and ascending name cascades with semantic barriers.
  • Margin-aware declaration/call wrapping, fluent chains and packed argument rows.
  • Configurable block, statement, annotation, lambda, condition and case layout.
  • Parameter/argument order, literals and comments protected by PSI-based processing.
  • Documented settings, architecture, save/commit integration and profile sharing.
  • Java/Kotlin examples distributed as text resources instead of compiled sample classes.
